verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents typed official SDKs across ten languages. It also has dedicated first-party pages for its JavaScript/TypeScript client (Node, browser, edge) and its Python client (async, type hints), plus a first-party Laravel Scout driver. Community reports add caveats on SDK maturity: a .NET client still alpha at 1.0, and a Rails gem that fell out of step with the server. Missing for 10: in-depth docs evidenced for SDKs beyond JS/Python, independent hands-on corroboration that SDKs stay current with server releases.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Typed SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, and .NET.
The official JavaScript client for Meilisearch, with full TypeScript support for Node.js and browser environments.
The official Python client for Meilisearch with async support and type hints.
First-party Meilisearch driver for Laravel Scout, the official Laravel search package.
